title: Super Foot
description:
A fully audio football game, played entirely by ear in the browser on a computer or phone, with nothing to install.

- Full matches with live commentary, crowd atmosphere and sound effects
- Simple keyboard controls; on a touchscreen you play with swipes and taps anywhere on the screen (gesture mode works best with the screen reader off)
- Solo against the AI, or online against a friend: send them a link and the match starts, penalty shootouts included
- Several competitions (Champions League, Euro, World Cup, CAN) with the real 2026-27 squads
- Installable as an app from Chrome, and solo mode works offline
- Fully playable in English and French (language button at the top of the page)
